target_customer: Developers and companies building AI agents that need to call and text people
problem: Agents lack a phone identity; telecom setup and compliance are built for humans and are painful via raw Twilio.
business_model: Usage-based API: numbers from $3 per month, calls from 13 cents per minute, SMS from 2 cents per segment
product_category: Telephony API and MCP server for AI agents

founders.name: Manav Modi
prior_employers: Vogue app revamp work, employer not stated on YC page
education: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, BS Computer Engineering

founders.name: Meet Modi
education: UCLA, BS Computer Science and Linguistics
founders.background_notes: Per YC page. A third-party directory says the two are brothers.

competitors.name: Twilio
competitors.what: Programmable voice and SMS, DIY for agents

competitors.name: AgentCall
competitors.what: Phone number API for AI agents

technical_complexity.rationale: A wrapper over carriers and Twilio-like infrastructure with a unified webhook and MCP server; compliance (A2P, number provisioning) is the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Built on third-party telecom rails; easy for Twilio or Vapi to bundle similar agent-first features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not resolved as of 2026-11. Telnyx has partnered with agent inbox startup AgentMail, showing incumbents moving into the area.

market_need_then: Agents were acting in the real world through messaging and calls in 2026, and no trusted agent phone identity existed per the founders' launch framing.

identity.mascot_or_character: Cartoon mascot shown in several poses on the site
identity.visual_style: Clean, modern, blue and white with simple illustrations

branding.community_and_virality: Listed across directories and an HN showcase post; no merch or fan evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive, memorable name and a mascot on the site; several unrelated AgentPhone and Agent-prefixed products exist.

outcome_analysis: Active in YC Spring 2026 with a clear wedge and a technical founding pair that includes a Meta agent infrastructure engineer. Outcome unknown: the rails are rented and incumbents can copy the wedge, but it has early ecosystem integrations.
notes: Directories list about $500K seed or pre-seed with YC, David Lieb, Grey Baker, Swift Ventures and Rebel Fund; sources disagree on stage and none is primary, so no round is recorded. Legal entity per everydev is Relay Innovations, Inc. Outcome searches found nothing.
